_comment: Baselines for the AIR erasure gate. total_unproven_retain = bucket-C ceiling (C must never grow). provable_fixtures_must_be_clean = programs that must compile to zero surviving axis calls / abort paths. expected_drifts = fixtures whose declared-vs-measured mismatch is a KNOWN, documented modeling gap (AIR does not yet declare that residue); a drift OUTSIDE this list is a regression to investigate.

llvm_unsupported.03_secure_slot: LLVM backend rejects tuple-destructure `let (slot, token) = ClaimSecureSlot()` ('requires an explicitly typed binding'); the C backend accepts it. A real C/LLVM surface-coverage divergence found by parity.ps1. The class-field secure-slot form (08) compiles on both backends.
